drafted.title: Vite Throws `Module "fs" has been externalized for browser compatibility` When Browser Code Imports Node Built-ins
drafted.description: Explain why Vite externalizes Node built-ins in browser bundles and how to keep server-only modules out of client code.
drafted.angle: Open with the exact Vite error and the import chain that reaches `fs`, `path`, or another Node built-in. Explain how Vite decides what belongs in the client bundle and why server-only modules must not be pulled through a shared entry point. Show how to separate client and server imports, use conditional code paths or `.server` files where appropriate, and confirm the bundle no longer includes Node-only dependencies.
